title: Oozing Caramel Greek Honey Loukoumades
description: Rich, dense, and adventurous Greek dessert featuring caramelized honey and a surprising twist with ketchup, made egg-free-friendly in a loukoumades form
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the sifted flour, granulated sugar, and salt
In a separate bowl, whisk together the milk, melted butter, and vanilla extract
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until a smooth batter forms
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let the batter rest in a warm place for 1 hour
Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375 degrees Fahrenheit
Using a spoon, drop the batter into the hot oil, making sure not to overcrowd the pan
Fry the loukoumades for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown
Remove the loukoumades from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil
Drizzle the caramel sauce and Greek honey over the warm loukoumades
Serve the oozing caramel Greek honey loukoumades immediately and enjoy
